title: Seal's Price
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record's cold whispers reverberated through Chen Ji's Mental Sea—"Chapter Seven Hundred, your death mark is set. However, there is one variable... your sister." Chen Ji gripped the fragment with white-knuckled force. Chen Nian... what secrets is she still hiding?

text.content: The manic laughter that Ling Yuan had released at the moment of his defeat still echoed, the words like万年寒冰 piercing Chen Ji's heart—the truth behind his father's death was far more brutal than imagined. He knelt on the shattered jade floor, chest heaving, fingertips digging into his palms as blood dripped through the cracks, blooming dark red flowers on the cold stone. "Father..." His voice was hoarse and barely recognizable, each word seeming to tear from his chest. The Tianji Record fragment suddenly shuddered violently, dense cracks emerging on the yellowed page as if something was awakening within. Chen Ji jerked his head up, pupils constricting—he felt an unprecedented surge of power breaking through the seal's restraints, rushing toward him.

"The fourth layer of the seal... is loosening?" Chen Ji murmured, then gritted his teeth and forced himself to stand. He knew this was no time for weakness—every anomaly of the Tianji Record signaled a turning point in destiny. He sat cross-legged, formed seals with his hands, and gently extended his divine sense into the yellowed fragment. As his consciousness delved deeper, a vast and ancient torrent of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a breached dam—countless prophecy fragments, threads of fate, and shards of truth buried by time. He saw the hundred-year rise and fall of the Tianqing Sect, the scheming and power struggles between the three great sects, and more importantly... himself. Chen Ji froze, the vision before him making him feel as though he had fallen into an ice pit: he saw himself collapsed in a pool of blood, surrounded by mountain-high corpses, and in the distant horizon, a blurry figure watching him. Below the image, a line of golden characters was clearly inscribed—"Chapter Seven Hundred · Deadly Trap."

dialogue.content: "Do you see it? This is your destined ending." Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rose from the depths of the fragment, carrying an ineffable mix of pity and helplessness. "The Tianji Record never prophesies coincidence—it records the inevitable. And you, in Chapter Seven Hundred, will die without doubt." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat beading on his forehead. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down: "Death is certain? Hmph, there has never been an absolute certainty in this world. Since you're willing to tell me these things, Mo Xiansheng, there must still be room for maneuver." Cracks continued spreading across the fragment as a brilliant silver light burst from the fissures, shooting toward the heavens. At the same time, Chen Ji felt a burning force gathering in his Mental Sea—the new ability granted after the fourth seal of the Tianji Record was lifted.

text.content: "Breaking Destiny's Eye." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time with a grave tone. "This is the ultimate手段 granted to prophets by the Tianji Record—it allows you to glimpse a thread of生机 at the final moment before death's fate arrives. But every use comes with a price." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "What price?" Mo Xiansheng's answer made his pupils contract sharply: "Lifespan. Every time you use the Breaking Destiny's Eye, you forfeit ten years of life. If pushed to its极限 during a life-or-death moment... a single use can cost thirty years." Chen Ji felt his scalp go numb—thirty years of lifespan, almost half a mortal's lifetime. But what chilled him more was Mo Xiansheng continuing: "Moreover, the Breaking Destiny's Eye has a cumulative erosion effect. Each use加重s the next backlash by ten percent. If you rely on this ability too much before Chapter Seven Hundred arrives..." Mo Xiansheng did not finish, but the meaning was crystal clear.

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then a cold smile curved his lips: "So the Tianji Record's new ability is actually a sweet poison? Letting me see hope for survival, yet slowly squeezing out my life as I chase that hope?" Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before sighing: "The Tianji Record is never a charitable object—everything it gives has a clear price. The Breaking Destiny's Eye lets you see a glimmer of hope in a certain death trap, but the cost is your lifespan... and more." Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his gaze resolute and sharp: "Then let me see exactly what this Breaking Destiny's Eye can reveal!" He activated his divine sense, proactively touching that newly-formed silver eye. In an instant, his vision underwent an earth-shaking change—he saw countless possible paths of destiny, each timeline intertwined like glowing threads in the Void, and at the end of those threads, some led to light, some to abyss, and others... to a blurred gray.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils narrowed slightly. He discovered that among those threads of fate, there was one particularly special dim thread—no matter how he tried to focus, he could not see what lay at its end. At the source of that thread, a slender figure stood vaguely—long hair cascading like a waterfall, features blurred, yet giving him an incomparably familiar warmth. "That is..." Just as he was about to look closer, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "Don't look. That is your sister—Chen Nian." Chen Ji shuddered: "Nian'er?" Mo Xiansheng continued: "Her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—any fate thread she participates in becomes blurred. But one thing is certain—she is the key variable to breaking your death destiny. If you can find her, and have her stand by your side..." Mo Xiansheng hesitated, "perhaps the deadly trap of Chapter Seven Hundred will no longer be the only ending."

Chen Ji stared fixedly at that faint thread of fate, his hands unconsciously clenching into fists. Finding Chen Nian—this thought grew ever more resolute in his heart. Yet he knew, before that, he must become stronger. Although the side effects of the Breaking Bureau Eye were terrifying, for someone who had long since made peace with death, what were ten or twenty years of lifespan? "Mo Xiansheng." he suddenly spoke, his voice low and cold, "I accept the side effects of the Breaking Bureau Eye. But I have one question—if I remove all the seals of the Tianji Record before Chapter Seven Hundred arrives, can this so-called inevitable fate... be rewritten?" Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long time, so long that Chen Ji thought he would never answer. Just as Chen Ji was about to press further, a long sigh drifted from the depths of the fragment: "The Tianji Record has nine layers of seals, each sealing different levels of prophetic power and fragments of truth. After removing them all, you would indeed possess the power to rewrite fate... but the price is—" Mo Xiansheng paused, "You will become the next Heavenly Celestial Eye."

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a flicker of disbelief flashing through his pupils: "Heavenly Celestial Eye? You mean... the Heavenly Celestial Will that is said to control the prophets throughout the ages?" Mo Xiansheng's voice became ethereal and distant: "Correct. The Heavenly Celestial Eye is not a specific powerful individual, but the ultimate destination of every Tianji Record master. When you unseal all nine layers and gain power sufficient to rewrite fate, your consciousness will completely merge with the Tianji Record, becoming a new Heavenly Celestial Will... or rather, becoming its puppet." Chen Ji felt a chill rise from his spine, but he quickly suppressed his fear, saying coldly: "So the Tianji Record was a scam from the start? Give prophets power, let them think they can rewrite fate, and in the end turn them all into pieces on the Heavenly Celestial Will's chessboard?" Mo Xiansheng did not deny: "This is the truth of the Tianji Record—or rather, its cruelest essence."

dialogue.content: "Then I should thank you for your honesty." Chen Ji sneered, though there was no笑意 in his eyes, "But, Mo Xiansheng... since you know all this, why have you been guiding me step by step to where I am today?" Silence held in the depths of the fragment for a moment before Mo Xiansheng's aged and weary voice came: "Because you are the only person who might be able to break this cycle." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "Oh?" Mo Xiansheng continued: "Every Tianji Record master throughout history, upon learning the truth, chose to give up. They either settled for the status quo, destroyed their Tianji Records, or completely became puppets of the Heavenly Celestial Will. But you are different—your heart holds obsession, hatred, the determination to protect, and even more..." Mo Xiansheng paused, "Even more, a contempt for fate. These things might allow you to find the third path that predecessors could not find." Hearing this, a meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "A third path? Interesting. Then let me try to see where this path leads!"

text.content: At that moment, the silver glow on the Tianji Record fragment gradually收敛, and the newly formed Breaking Bureau Eye slowly sank into the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, transforming into a faintly pulsing silver point of light. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power circulating through his body—his spiritual awareness expanded dramatically, his perception multiplied several times over, and more crucially, he had gained a completely new skill: "Fate Scrutiny." With a thought, a虚幻 picture展开 before his eyes: this was a concrete visualization of his current attributes. Combat Power showed a slight increase, strategy steadily improving, but Heavenly Fate... plummeted from one hundred points to eighty-five. "As expected, every use of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate." Chen Ji murmured softly, "And the Breaking Bureau Eye, as a new ability, has an even more staggering consumption." He clenched his fists, feeling the surging power within, yet his heart remained ice-cold. Power was good, but the price was too heavy—he must use this double-edged sword cautiously.

Just as Chen Ji was organizing his newly acquired abilities, urgent footsteps suddenly came from the distance. His brow furrowed slightly as he looked up to see a blue figure swiftly approaching—it was Su Qingyao. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's face was full of anxiety, her clothes still adorned with several leaves, clearly having rushed all the way here. "Chen Ji!" she shouted from afar, and by the time she reached him, she was already breathless, "Are you alright? I sensed intense spiritual energy fluctuations from the direction of Tianqing Peak, and I thought..." Her words abruptly stopped, for only now did she notice the scene before her—shattered jade scattered across the ground, residual狂暴energy lingering in the air, and Chen Ji's rather pale complexion. A flash of suspicion crossed Su Qingyao's eyes as she stepped forward, reaching for Chen Ji's forehead: "What happened? Why does your face look so terrible?"

Chen Ji subtly shifted his body, deftly evading Su Qingyao's hand. He put on his usual timid smile, his voice carrying a hint of apology: "Senior Sister Su, I'm fine... I just had some mishap during cultivation and alarmed Senior Sister, truly sorry." Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly, her gaze scanning Chen Ji's face repeatedly, those sharp eyes seeming to want to pierce through all his pretense: "Mishap? You think I can't see through this? This level of spiritual energy fluctuation is at least what remains after a Core Formation expert's confrontation. Chen Ji, what exactly are you hiding?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained calm: "Senior Sister is overthinking, I really just—" "Enough!" Su Qingyao suddenly raised her voice, cutting him off, "You think I can't see through it? From the day you entered the Tianqing Sect, you've been pretending. That bullied waste servant disciple, that废物 without even a spiritual root... it was all an act!" Her voice trembled slightly, whether from anger or some other emotion unclear.

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, the timid smile on his face gradually fading, replaced by a deep and tranquil expression. He stared directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, his voice low: "Senior Sister Su, what answer are you looking for?" Su Qingyao was startled by his sudden change in aura, stepping back half a pace, but she quickly steadied herself, biting her lip: "I only want to know the truth. Who are you really? What is your purpose in approaching Tianqing Sect, in approaching me?" Chen Ji looked at her, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. After a moment, he said softly: "Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is... I never intended to harm you." Su Qingyao was stunned, then laughed coldly: "You think saying that, I would believe you?" Chen Ji shook his head: "Believe it or not is up to you. But Senior Sister Su, there are some things - the more you know, the faster you die." He paused, turning to gaze at the distant horizon, his voice ethereal, "If one day you find yourself on the edge of danger, I will appear... even if you hate me to the bone."

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning, how should Chen Ji choose? Continue hiding the truth to protect her, or reveal partial information to draw her into the chess game?

choices.description: Maintain the废物 persona, use lies to temporarily appease Su Qingyao, avoid her getting involved in deeper troubles
choices.visible_cost: Lose a chance to gain Su Qingyao's trust
choices.visible_reward: Stay low-profile, avoid drawing attention from other forces
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's affection may decrease, she will become more obsessed with investigating the truth

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his voice carrying a hint of helplessness and exhaustion: "Senior Sister, you really think too much. I'm just a piece of luckier trash. The disturbance just now was... the Sect Master fighting someone, I was just an innocent bystander caught in the crossfire." Su Qingyao looked at him with suspicion, clearly not believing much, but Chen Ji had already turned to walk down the mountain. His back looked so thin and lonely, completely different from that sharp-eyed man just moments ago. "I will investigate and find out everything." Su Qingyao said quietly behind him, her tone somewhat stubborn, "No matter who you are, I will find the truth!" Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, but he didn't look back, continuing forward. He knew Su Qingyao's investigation might bring her danger... but now, he still didn't have the ability to protect her. Not yet at least.

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao he is the holder of the Tianji Record, but conceal key information and the ultimate price
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may fall into danger because she knows too much
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial trust from a powerful ally, her "Shared Fate" buff may unlock early
choices.risk_hint: Once leaked, it will attract more forces' covetousness
choices.process_label: 陈机选择透露部分真相

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, standing with his back to Su Qingyao in silence for a long while. When he spoke again, his voice carried an unprecedented weariness: "Senior Sister... do you want to know the truth?" Su Qingyao's heart jumped, instinctively tightening her grip on the sword hilt at her waist. Chen Ji turned around, those usually timid eyes now deep as an abyss, as if holding endless stars and darkness. "I really am not trash." he said softly, "I have a treasure... that can foresee the future. It was by relying on it that I was able to step by step reach where I am today." Su Qingyao shuddered, disbelief flickering in her eyes: "Foresee the future? This... how is this possible?" Chen Ji forced a bitter smile: "I know it sounds absurd, but that's the fact. However, Senior Sister..." he stared directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, his expression solemn, "Every use of this treasure comes with a price, and those who know of its existence will be drawn into dangerous whirlpools. Are you certain... you want to continue asking?" Su Qingyao bit her lip, her gaze determined: "I've been investigating for too long. Whatever lies ahead, I must know!"

choices.description: Don't answer directly, instead use the Tianji Record to show Su Qingyao a prophetic fragment about herself, to shift the topic and test her reaction
choices.visible_cost: Expose some abilities of the Tianji Record, risk of intelligence leakage
choices.visible_reward: Grasp Su Qingyao's weaknesses or secrets, gain the initiative in subsequent power plays
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may completely become hostile to Chen Ji, thinking he is threatening her

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer directly, but slowly walked toward Su Qingyao, stopping three feet in front of her. His gaze became deep and sharp, as if seeing through all pretense: "Senior Sister, instead of obsessing over who I am, let me... tell you a secret." Su Qingyao frowned slightly: "What secret?" A meaningful arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: "In three days, you will encounter a life-and-death crisis in the Forbidden Grounds of the Rear Mountain. If no one helps, you will..." He deliberately paused, observing the changes in Su Qingyao's expression. As expected, Su Qingyao's face instantly turned deathly pale, her hand holding the sword trembling. "You... how do you know about this?" Her voice carried a tremor, "I never told anyone about this matter..." Chen Ji's heart tightened inwardly. He hadn't expected his随口一说 prophecy to actually hit upon Su Qingyao's secret. This meant her fate trajectory had indeed intersected with his own—or rather, the Tianji Record had long bound him and Su Qingyao together in the darkness of destiny. "Now, Senior Sister, do you still think I'm just a lucky piece of trash?" Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried an undeniable pressure.

After handling matters with Su Qingyao, Chen Ji returned alone to the remote courtyard where the Servant Disciples lived. Pushing open the door, the room was dim, only a few strands of moonlight filtering through the window lattice, casting mottled shadows on the floor. He closed the door, sat cross-legged on the simple bed, closed his eyes, and began to carefully sense the newly obtained power within his body. The Breaking Situation Eye had completely merged with his divine consciousness, and he could clearly perceive that silver light point quietly suspended in the depths of his Mental Sea, like a dormant seed, ready to break through the soil at its master's command. However, accompanying the power was a heavy price—his lifespan had quietly decreased by fifteen years. Had he not stepped onto the path of cultivation, with his original mortal body, these fifteen years would have been enough to take him from prime to twilight years. "Chapter Seven Hundred... Death Prophecy." Chen Ji murmured, his brow furrowed, "Before that, I must find Chen Nian, must unlock all the seals of the Tianji Record, must find that... the third path that predecessors could not find."

As Chen Ji was lost in contemplation, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea flickered with a faint glow once more. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice sounded unhurriedly: "Master, there is one more thing I must tell you." Chen Ji's brow slightly stirred: "Speak." Mo Xiansheng's voice turned exceptionally grave: "What Ling Yuan said before his death... about the truth of your father's death." Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted, a chill rising from his spine. Mo Xiansheng continued: "He was right. Your father's death was no accident, but... deliberately arranged. And that person has countless connections to the Eye of Heavenly Way." Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, knuckles turning white, joints cracking. His voice was low and dangerous: "Who?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long time, long enough for Chen Ji to think he wouldn't speak again. Finally, a heavy sigh came from the depths of the fragment: "Do you truly wish to know? After knowing this truth, you may... fall into complete madness."

"Heh..." Chen Ji let out a low, hollow laugh, containing no joy whatsoever, only endless coldness and sarcasm, "So that's how it is. So Han Lie's constant targeting of me wasn't without reason... He knew about our grudge from the very beginning." Mo Xiansheng sighed: "When Han Xiaotian received the order from the Eye of Heavenly Way to eliminate dissidents, he didn't know he was merely a chess piece. And Han Lie... he may know the truth, or he may not. But one thing is certain—his hostility toward you is far more than just a genius's arrogance." Chen Ji slowly stood up, walked to the window, gazing at the cold, bright moon in the night sky. His back appeared exceptionally lonely under the moonlight, yet there was an indescribable resolve. "Han Xiaotian... Han Lie..." he murmured these two names, the coldness in his eyes nearly freezing the air, "Good, another enemy I must defeat." He turned around, his gaze falling on the faintly pulsing silver light in his Mental Sea—the Eye of Breaking the Game. "But before settling accounts with them, I need to survive until chapter seven hundred."

"Heh..." Chen Ji let out a low, hollow laugh, containing no joy whatsoever, only endless coldness and sarcasm, "So that's how it is. So Han Lie's constant targeting of me wasn't without reason... He knew about our grudge from the very beginning." Mo Xiansheng sighed: "When Han Xiaotian received the order from the Eye of Heavenly Way to eliminate dissidents, he didn't know he was merely a chess piece. And Han Lie... he may know the truth, or he may not. But one thing is certain—his hostility toward you is far more than just a genius's arrogance." Chen Ji slowly stood up, walked to the window, gazing at the cold, bright moon in the night sky. His back appeared exceptionally lonely under the moonlight, yet there was an indescribable resolve. "Han Xiaotian... Han Lie..." he murmured these two names, the coldness in his eyes nearly freezing the air, "Good, another enemy I must defeat." He turned around, his gaze falling on the faintly pulsing silver light in his Mental Sea—the Eye of Breaking the Game. "But before settling accounts with them, I need to survive until chapter seven hundred."

The cracks on the Tianji Record Fragment continued spreading slowly. Although the fourth layer of seal had loosened, it hadn't been completely released. Chen Ji could sense vast information and power still locked within deeper restrictions, waiting for that moment of release. "Mo Xiansheng." he suddenly spoke, "If I want to speed up the unsealing, what should I do?" Mo Xiansheng沉吟片刻 answered: "The Tianji Record's seal is closely tied to the master's strength, strategy, and control over destiny. Simply put, you need to do two things—first, constantly achieve victories to accumulate fortune; second, find more Tianji Record fragments and merge them into one." Chen Ji nodded, this matched his previous speculation. He currently held only three pages of Tianji Record fragments, while the complete Tianji Record supposedly had nine pages. If all fragments could be gathered, perhaps he might glimpse the so-called third path. "Gathering fragments..." he murmured, "It seems I need to accelerate my pace."

Just then, Chen Ji suddenly felt a strong wave of dizziness wash over him. He braced himself against the wall, brow furrowed—the backlash from the Eye of Breaking the Game's first use. His vision began showing blurry images—fragments of the River of Destiny: a blood-red sky, collapsed mountains, and a vague figure watching him from afar. The figure's face was obscured by a layer of mist, but Chen Ji could sense the ice-cold cruelty within those eyes—an existence transcending human comprehension, viewing all things as mere ants. "That's..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, an inexplicable fear rising from his heart. Mo Xiansheng's voice适时响起，带着前所未有的凝重："那就是天道之眼的本体投影。它已经注意到你了...或者说，从你获得天机录的那一刻起，它就一直在注视着你。" Chen Ji stared fixedly at that blurry figure, emotions churning in his heart—fear, fury, or... unwillingness?

"Let it watch then." Chen Ji suddenly let out a cold laugh, that smirk carrying an almost deranged pride, "Think you can make me a chess piece? Let's see if you have the ability!" He fiercely activated his divine sense, launching a challenge toward that blurry figure. In an instant, his vision became extremely clear—he saw the true form of the Eye of Heavenly Way, existing only in legends: a massive vertical pupil, containing within it the operational laws of the entire universe, countless threads of destiny extending from it, weaving into a great net shrouding all worlds. And at the center of that net, a familiar figure was bound by countless threads, unable to move—Chen Nian! Chen Ji trembled all over, eyes crimson: "Nian'er!" At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with blinding light, pulling Chen Ji back to reality from that terrifying illusion. He gasped heavily, cold sweat already soaking through his clothes. Mo Xiansheng's voice came, carrying a warning: "Master, your current strength is still insufficient to gaze directly at the Eye of Heavenly Way. Remember, before you grow strong enough... don't provoke it again."

Chen Ji did not answer, merely gripping his fists so tightly that his fingernails deeply embedded into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. The scene just witnessed had brought him immense shock—Chen Nian imprisoned by the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate, bound by countless threads of fate, becoming its tool for manipulating destiny. This image struck him with more anger and heartache than any death prophecy. "Nian'er..." His voice was hoarse and low, carrying suppressed fury pushed to the extreme, "Wait for me... I will definitely rescue you." The cracks on the Tianji Record Fragment deepened once more, as if responding to his determination. Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming his turbulent emotions, and reexamined his current situation. The Eye of Breaking the Game had been successfully activated, and the power boost from this new ability was real and tangible; the fourth layer of seals was loosening, more truth and power awaiting to be unsealed; but at the same time, the cost was heavy—lifespan diminished, Heavenly Fate Value plummeting, and he had been completely exposed under the gaze of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate. This game of chess was becoming increasingly dangerous.

"Regardless, survive first." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice carrying a resolute determination, "Only by surviving can one have the qualification to speak of revenge and redemption." He settled cross-legged on the bed again, beginning to circulate his cultivation technique, regulating his breath and nourishing his spirit. Too many things had happened tonight—Ling Yuan's betrayal and death, the truth behind his father's death, the awakening of the Eye of Breaking the Game, and... the image of Chen Nian being imprisoned. All of this pressed against his heart like giant boulders, almost suffocating him. But Chen Ji knew, he could not fall. At least before achieving his goal, he could not fall. The moonlight outside the window gradually dimmed, and the eastern horizon showed a hint of dawn's early light. A new day was about to arrive, and his chess game was just beginning.

"It's dawn." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the gradually brightening sky outside the window. His face still appeared somewhat pale, but his eyes had already recovered their usual calmness and depth. He stood up, stretched his stiff muscles, and began calculating his subsequent plans. First, he needed to continue playing the role of that useless servant disciple, not arousing any suspicion. Second, he needed to quickly find the whereabouts of the other Tianji Record fragments, strengthening his power. Finally, and most importantly—he needed to find Chen Nian. No matter what price he had to pay, he would rescue his sister from the hands of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate. Suddenly, a knock came at the door, and a servant disciple poked his head in: "Chen Ji, the Sect Master requests your presence. Go to the Council Hall." Chen Ji's brow slightly raised, a trace of doubt flashing through his heart—Sect Master? Wasn't the Tianqing Sect's Sect Master Ling Yuan? Hadn't he already been defeated? It seemed that during the time he was unconscious, many things he didn't know about had occurred.

dialogue.content: In the Council Hall, the atmosphere was oppressively suffocating. When Chen Ji stepped into the main hall, the first thing he saw was the elder seated in the main position—the legendary father of Ling Yuan, True Lord Ling Tian. This legendary supreme expert was currently squinting his eyes, studying Chen Ji, his gaze carrying an inexplicable meaning. Chen Ji stepped forward and saluted: "Disciple Chen Ji, pays respects to Sect Master True Lord." True Lord Ling Tian smiled faintly, that smile appearing kind on the surface, yet giving Chen Ji an inexplicable chill: "Chen Ji... what a good name. I heard you had a fortuitous encounter in the Forbidden Grounds last night and obtained quite a significant opportunity?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unchanged: "Disciple merely had good luck, stumbled upon it by chance..." True Lord Ling Tian raised his hand to interrupt: "No need for false modesty. This old one summoned you to bestow upon you a great blessing." His voice unhurriedly sounded, "From today onward, you shall be an Inner Disciple of the Tianqing Sect." With these words, whispers immediately erupted throughout the Council Hall. Countless gazes of surprise, jealousy, or disdain fell upon Chen Ji, yet he remained unmoved, merely slightly lowering his eyes, hiding all his sharpness deep within.

text.content: "Inner Disciple..." Chen Ji quietly repeated these words, while his mind was rapidly calculating. True Lord Ling Tian's move was by no means kind—a useless servant disciple leaping to become an Inner Disciple overnight, this news spreading out would be enough to cause a sensation throughout the entire Tianqing Sect. More importantly, this was clearly putting him on the rack, making him a target for everyone's attacks. "So True Lord Ling Tian has already sensed something." Chen Ji sneered in his heart, "Using this method to push me into the spotlight—is he trying to force me to reveal my hand?" However, on the surface he only showed an expression of being overwhelmed by unexpected honor, kneeling and kowtowing: "Disciple... disciple is unworthy of such kindness from the Sect Master!" True Lord Ling Tian stroked his beard, nodding with a smile: "Good, good, good. It's good that a young person has such humility. However..." His gaze suddenly turned sharp, "Since you've become an Inner Disciple, you must have some presentable skills. This old one heard you have some grudge with Han Lie, so in the Sect Competition three days from now, you shall represent the Tianqing Sect in battle." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted—Sect Competition, opponent Han Lie? Was True Lord Ling Tian planning to eliminate him through Han Lie's hands, or did he have other schemes?

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze calmly meeting True Lord Ling Tian's eyes. In that instant, he seemed to see something familiar in the other party's eyes—it was the kind of playful anticipation a hunter shows when watching prey fall into a trap. But Chen Ji was not flustered; instead, the corners of his mouth slightly lifted, revealing a meaningful smile. "Disciple... accepts the order." He kowtowed once more, his voice steady without a trace of fluctuation. True Lord Ling Tian clearly hadn't expected him to agree so readily; a flash of surprise crossed his eyes, but quickly recovered his kind smile: "Good, good, good. Indeed, a hero comes from the youth. Then go prepare. This old one will personally watch the Sect Competition three days from now." Chen Ji saluted and took his leave, turning to walk out of the Council Hall. His back view still appeared so frail and humble, like a withered leaf that could be blown away by wind at any moment. But only he himself knew—a greater storm was brewing. The Sect Competition three days from now... Han Lie... True Lord Ling Tian's scheming... and the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate that had always been watching him from the shadows. Everything would reach its turning point on that day. And Chen Ji, was already prepared.

Walking out of the Council Hall, Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the cool morning air fill his lungs. The Tianji Record Fragment pulsed gently in his Mental Sea, as if also anticipating the upcoming battle. The new abilities of the Eye of Breaking the Game gave him more confidence for the match three days later, but he knew that his current strength was still insufficient for a direct confrontation with Han Lie. Han Lie was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, with Combat Power that defied heaven, and was bolstered by countless resources and secret techniques. If he wanted to defeat Han Lie in the Sect Competition, Chen Ji would need to find another way. 'Eye of Breaking the Game...' he murmured, 'Perhaps it's time to thoroughly study how to use this new ability.' He gazed toward the distant horizon—that was the direction of the Xuanwu Sect. Through the Tianji Record's perception, he could even faintly sense Han Lie's狂暴而灼热的气息... 'Han Lie...' A cold smile curved the corners of Chen Ji's mouth, 'The debt your father owes will be collected from you.'

Returning to the Servants' Quarters small courtyard, Chen Ji once again took out the Tianji Record Fragment and began carefully studying the various uses of the Eye of Breaking the Game. Through his exchanges with Mo Xiansheng, he gradually mapped out the ability boundaries of this silver eye—first, it allowed Chen Ji to glimpse a sliver of survival at the moment before death's fate descended; second, it could vaguely perceive the direction of fate's threads, helping him find key variables in events; third, and most powerful, the Eye of Breaking the Game could briefly 'see through' an opponent's attack trajectories, giving him the upper hand in battle. 'Seeing through techniques...' A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, 'If I can predict Han Lie's attack trajectories in battle beforehand, the odds of victory will greatly increase.' However, the cost was equally terrifying—each use of the Eye of Breaking the Game would shave off his lifespan. If he overused it during the Sect Competition three days later, he might die from exhausted lifespan before even reaching the death prophecy in Chapter 700. 'It seems I'll need to find a balance between consumption and benefit.' Chen Ji murmured to himself.

Just as Chen Ji was racking his brains for a strategy, an urgent knocking came at the door. His brow furrowed slightly as he rose to open it, only to see a black figure flash inside like a specter—it was Ye Qing, the Holy Sect saint of the Demonic Path. Dressed in a black skirt that accentuated her curvaceous figure, her expression carried a hint of gravity. 'Why are you here?' Chen Ji asked in a lowered voice, while his spiritual sense swept the surroundings, confirming they hadn't been discovered. Ye Qing didn't beat around the bush, getting straight to the point: 'I received news—Ling Tian Zhenren intends to make a move against you during the Sect Competition three days from now.' Chen Ji's brow rose slightly: 'I already guessed that.' Ye Qing shook her head: 'What you don't know is that he plans to use an ancient forbidden artifact—the Heaven-Swallowing Earth-Binding Talisman. That thing can seal off the entire Arena, rendering all defensive talismans and escape techniques completely useless. Han Lie is already several realms stronger than you, and with this artifact...' She didn't finish, but the meaning was abundantly clear—this was a death trap. Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then a meaningful smile curved his lips: 'An ancient forbidden artifact? Interesting... Ling Tian Zhenren has really spared no expense.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji's nonchalant expression, her brow creasing even tighter: 'Do you even understand what I'm saying? Once the Heaven-Swallowing Earth-Binding Talisman activates, even if you had heaven-reaching abilities, you wouldn't escape! Unless...' She paused, pulling out a pitch-black Jade Slip from her sleeve, 'Unless you can master this technique within three days—the advanced version of 'Demonic Path Mist'—the 'Heavenly Demon Unbinding Great Method.' This is a forbidden technique of the Holy Sect. Once successfully cultivated, it can multiply your strength tenfold in a short time, enough to battle Han Lie.' Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his brow furrowing: 'Heavenly Demon Unbinding Great Method? The name doesn't sound like anything good.' Ye Qing gave a bitter smile: 'Indeed it's not. The price of this technique is that after casting it, you'll fall into a month-long period of weakness, during which your strength will decrease by ninety percent.' Chen Ji played with the Jade Slip in his hand, falling into deep thought. On one side was a certain death trap, on the other was a mutually destructive fighting method... Ling Tian Zhenren's scheme was indeed ruthless. But when had Chen Ji ever walked an ordinary path? 'Ye Qing...' he suddenly spoke up, 'Why are you helping me?' Ye Qing froze for a moment, then turned her head away: '...Because you have use value. That's all.' Chen Ji gazed at her profile, a knowing smile curving his lips: 'Is that so? Then I thank you.'

text.content: After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji sat alone by the window, the pitch-black Jade Slip twirling between his fingers. The Heavenly Demon Unbinding Great Method was indeed a terrifyingly powerful forbidden technique, but the cost of a month-long weakness period was too heavy—during that time, he would become a lamb awaiting slaughter, and any enemy could easily take his life. Unless... he still had other trump cards. Chen Ji closed his eyes, his spiritual sense sinking deep into the depths of his Mental Sea, arriving before that faintly pulsing silver speck of light—the Eye of Breaking the Game. He tried communicating with it: 'Can you help me see through the weaknesses of the Heaven-Swallowing Earth-Binding Talisman?' The silver speck quivered slightly, as if responding to his inquiry. A moment later, a stream of information flooded into his mind—that was all sorts of information about the Heaven-Swallowing Earth-Binding Talisman, and... a deeply hidden fatal flaw. 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flickering in his pupils, 'Ling Tian Zhenren... you thought deploying the Heaven-Swallowing Earth-Binding Talisman would guarantee your victory? Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing—the bearer of the Tianji Record never walks an ordinary path.'

Three days passed in the blink of an eye. During these three days, Chen Ji continued to play the role of that cowardly, useless servant disciple during the day, while at night he hid in his small courtyard studying the abilities of the Tianji Record and the Eye of Breaking the Game. Through unremitting effort, he not only mastered the various uses of the Eye of Breaking the Game but also accidentally discovered a new function—'Fate Veiling.' This was a passive effect of the Eye of Breaking the Game, capable of briefly stripping his aura and fate threads away, preventing the Tianji Record or other prophecy-type artifacts from accurately capturing his movements. Of course, the consumption of this ability was equally considerable—each use would cost a full five points of Heavenly Fate. But for the upcoming Sect Competition, this might be a crucial trump card. 'Ling Tian Zhenren... Han Lie...' Chen Ji stood by the window, gazing at the gradually reddening dawn clouds on the horizon, a cold, razor-sharp smile curving his lips, 'Today, I'll let you see what it means to... play the pig to devour the tiger.'

The Sect Competition arrived as scheduled. The Tianqing Sect Martial Arena teemed with people as high-level representatives from the three major sects gathered, and countless disciples eagerly anticipated the event. Though today's confrontation was nominally a friendly exchange between the Tianqing Sect and the Xuanwu Sect, everyone knew it was actually a meticulously planned murder—Lingtian True Man intended to use Han Lie's hand to eliminate Chen Ji before the entire world. In the crowd, Su Qingyao tightly gripped the sword hilt at her waist, her gaze locked firmly on Chen Ji. For the past three days she had been investigating Chen Ji's secrets, yet found nothing. But a woman's intuition told her that today's Chen Ji would show her an entirely different face. On the other side, Han Lie strode onto the Arena Platform in golden battle armor, his face filled with arrogance. He looked down at Chen Ji, a disdainful cold smile at the corner of his lips: "Waste, you escaped last time—this time luck won't favor you." Chen Ji slowly walked onto the Arena Platform, his face pale, his body swaying as if a gust of wind could topple him. The台下 erupted in mockery and ridicule, yet only Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's eyes flickered with a hint of异样— both sensed that beneath Chen Ji's废物 exterior lay power sufficient to overturn everything.

Lingtian True Man sat upright on the high platform,眯着眼睛 watching the two on the Arena Platform. His fingers moved slightly, and an invisible spiritual power shot toward the formation runes surrounding the arena—the Tianluo Diwang Talisman had been silently activated. A faint golden light curtain rose from the ground, shrouding the entire Arena Platform. The audience below only felt their vision blur, unaware of what had transpired. Only a few elders with profound cultivation sensed the abnormality, yet they merely exchanged a meaningful glance without speaking to intervene. "The Tianluo Diwang Talisman has been activated." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, "From now on, all defensive talismans and escape arts are unusable. You have only one path—defeat Han Lie head-on." The corner of Chen Ji's lips lifted slightly, thinking to himself: "Defeat head-on? Perfect." He slowly raised his head, his gaze locking with Han Lie's. In those eyes filled with arrogance and contempt, Chen Ji saw familiar killing intent—the hatred originating from deep within the bloodline. "Han Lie." He suddenly spoke, his voice though not loud, clearly carrying across the entire Martial Arena, "Do you know... the grudge between us... was already established in the previous generation?"

Han Lie's brow furrowed slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to speak such words at this moment. But soon, he resumed his overbearing arrogant posture: "Previous generation? A废物 like you dares mention the previous generation?" Chen Ji shook his head, the timid expression on his face gradually fading, replaced by a deep and tranquil indifference: "Your father Han Shaotian, acting under the orders of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, murdered my father Chen Xuan twenty years ago. This blood debt... today, you shall repay it." At these words, the entire venue erupted. Han Shaotian's face instantly turned ashen, and a barely perceptible fierce glint flashed in Lingtian True Man's eyes. Only a few senior powerhouses on the high platform exchanged thoughtful glances—Chen Xuan's name was not unfamiliar to those old monsters who had lived long enough. "You... how do you know this?" Han Lie's voice trembled slightly, the emotion a mix of fury and shock, "Nonsense! My father is a hero of the Xuanwu Sect—how could he do such a thing!" Chen Ji coldly smiled: "Whether he did or not, battle will reveal the truth." He slowly raised his hand, the Breaking局之眼 quietly operating within his Mental Sea—a illusory image unfolding before his eyes—the attack trajectory of Han Lie's next three moves.

"Come then." Chen Ji said softly, his figure suddenly moving. Han Lie's pupils contracted slightly—he hadn't expected this废物 to dare take the initiative. But his shock lasted only an instant—immediately after, a savage flame erupted from his palm, transforming into a roaring fire lion rushing directly toward Chen Ji's face. This move came with tremendous force and astonishing speed—if hit, one would at least suffer severe injury if not death. A wave of exclamations rose from below. Yet the corner of Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile—the Breaking局之眼 had already seen this move's trajectory clearly. He sidestepped, the fire lion howling past his ear, not even touching the corner of his robe. "First move." He said quietly, his voice carrying a hint of indifferent mockery, "Han Lie's techniques are indeed fierce, but unfortunately... too straightforward." Han Lie's face drastically changed—he hadn't expected his confident strike to be dodged so easily. What made him even more难以置伩 was that Chen Ji's dodging angle and timing were impossibly precise, as if he had known from which direction the attack would come all along.

"Again!" Han Lie roared, both palms striking simultaneously as countless flames transformed into dozens of fire snakes, surrounding Chen Ji from all directions. This move sealed off all escape routes—in his view, Chen Ji had no way to avoid it. Yet Chen Ji moved as if strolling in a garden,穿梭自如 through the gaps between fire snakes. His movements appeared clumsy yet always avoided lethal damage at the final moment, like a swallow playing in tumultuous waves. "Second move." His voice sounded again, still that calm and从容. The venue below had exploded into chaos, countless disciples widened their eyes, not daring to believe what they witnessed—the person called废物，竟然能在韩烈的猛攻下毫发无伤？ Su Qingyao死死攥住剑柄，心跳如鼓—she finally understood that Chen Ji had been hiding his strength all these years, and today... he would当着天下人的面，撕碎所有轻视他的人.

"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" Han Lie was practically insane with rage; he could not accept being pushed to such a point by a废物. The pride of the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius completely destroyed his reason. He furiously mobilized all the spiritual energy in his body to unleash his strongest strike—"Black Tortoise Divine Fist: Heaven-Earth Destruction"! In an instant, the temperature across the entire Arena Platform soared. A massive fire fist capable of melting mountains and boiling seas rose behind him, carrying the might to destroy heaven and earth as it smashed toward Chen Ji. This move's power had already surpassed the Core Formation realm, reaching Nascent Soul-level destructive force. The elders below the platform changed color,，纷纷运转灵力准备随时出手阻止——他们担心的是陈机死后，这股余波会波及观众。凌天真人的嘴角勾起一抹冷笑——他仿佛已经看到了陈机被烧成灰烬的场景。然而陈机却站在原地一动不动，任凭那道火拳呼啸而来。他的眼睛微微闭上，破局之眼在他识海中疯狂运转，将这一招的所有变化都尽收眼底。

"Found it." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the sky-covering fire fist, yet a cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. He saw it—the center of that punch held a fist-sized vacuum point of spiritual energy. That was the rejection node between the Heaven-Encompassing Talisman and Han Lie's technique, the only flaw in this world-destroying strike. Faster than thought, Chen Ji's form flickered, actually charging toward the fire fist. Shouts of alarm rose from the crowd below—everyone thought he'd lost his mind, actually welcoming death head-on. But just as the fire fist was about to engulf him, Chen Ji slipped like a ghost into that tiny spiritual vacuum point, vanishing completely from Han Lie's sight. The next moment, the fire fist roared past his side, gouging out a massive crater in the arena platform behind him. Dust filled the air, rocks scattered. The crowd was dumbstruck, yet there stood Chen Ji, completely unharmed at the edge of the crater, gazing at Han Lie with a smile. "The third move, used up, I presume?" he said softly. "Now... it's my turn."

Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, an unprecedented fear flooding his heart. He wanted to strike again, only to find his body's spiritual energy completely depleted—that Heaven-Earth Destruction move had drained every ounce of his power. Yet Chen Ji behaved as if nothing had happened, walking toward him step by step. "You... what are you doing?" Han Lie's voice trembled, his former arrogance completely gone. Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply raised his hand slowly, a ball of ghostly blue spiritual light gathering in his palm. That was the power of the Break Pattern Eye—though it possessed no direct attack effect, it could instantly disrupt an opponent's spiritual energy circulation. "This palm is the interest owed to me for my father." Chen Ji said softly, the ghostly blue light in his palm shooting out and piercing into Han Lie's body. In that instant, Han Lie let out a miserable shriek, his entire body as if gripped by an invisible giant hand, his meridians thrown into chaos. He collapsed to his knees, blood flowing from all seven orifices, his entire body convulsing in agony.

"You... you..." Han Lie barely raised his head, his eyes filled with disbelief, terror, and fury. "How dare you... before all under heaven..." Chen Ji looked down at him from above, his smile growing colder: "Dare? What wouldn't I dare?" He crouched down to Han Lie's eye level, his voice extremely low, audible only to the two of them: "When your father killed my father all those years ago, did he ever imagine this day would come? The blood debt your Han family owes my Chen family—today is merely the beginning." Han Lie trembled throughout his body, whether from pain or fear he couldn't tell. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but found himself unable to speak. Chen Ji rose to his feet and looked around—at the spectators below, completely stunned, who now gazed at this once-ridiculed废物 disciple with nothing but reverence and fear. And on the high platform, Ling Tian Zhenren's face had darkened to the point of dripping ink. "First match, Tianqing Sect's Chen Ji... wins." The referee's voice rang out with difficulty, yet it was like igniting a fuse, plunging the entire Martial Arena into dead silence.

Chen Ji descended from the Arena Platform slowly, his steps steady, his expression calm, as if what had just transpired was merely a trivial matter. Yet as he passed Su Qingyao, she suddenly reached out and grabbed his sleeve. "Chen Ji..." Her voice was somewhat hoarse, her eyes flickering with complex emotions. "Who... exactly are you?" Chen Ji stopped, glancing at her sideways. Those eyes were deep as an abyss, as if hiding countless stars and darkness, yet also revealing an indescribable weariness and solitude. "Who I am doesn't matter." he said softly. "What matters is... that you're safe is enough." With that, he gently freed his sleeve from Su Qingyao's grasp and continued forward. Su Qingyao stood frozen in place, a nameless emotion surging in her heart—she suddenly understood: this man had been using that lowly exterior to protect something all along, and she... had perhaps been excluded from that protection from the very beginning. "The prophecy in three days..." she murmured to herself. "Did he expose his true strength on purpose to save me?"

Returning to his small courtyard, Chen Ji immediately closed the door and sat cross-legged on the bed. The Break Pattern Eye had been used three times in rapid succession at high intensity, each use consuming a tremendous amount of his energy and lifespan. Right now, he felt a fatigue unlike any he'd ever experienced, as if his entire being had been hollowed out. What alarmed him even more was that his Heavenly Fate Value had plummeted from one hundred points to seventy—this meant he had moved another step closer to the death prophecy in Chapter Seven Hundred. "The cost... is far too great." he murmured, his brow furrowed tightly. Though today's victory was exhilarating, the price paid was equally heavy. He would need to gather Heavenly Fate Value as quickly as possible in the days ahead; otherwise, once his Heavenly Fate was exhausted, what awaited him would be a fate far more terrible than death. However, before he could rest for long, hurried knocking echoed at his door, followed by a familiar voice: "Chen Ji, it's me, Ye Qing. Ling Tian Zhenren is moving against you—run!" Chen Ji's brow creased slightly as he rose. He knew Ling Tian Zhenren would never let this matter rest—today's public humiliation was hatred enough to make that old fox tear off all pretense.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened the door, and Ye Qing stood outside with an anxious expression. "Ling Tian Zhenren has already sent people to seal all exits of the Tianqing Sect. Your exposure of strength has completely exhausted his patience. He won't wait anymore—he's moving tonight!" Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed, yet a meaningful smile curled at the corner of his lips: "Good timing." Ye Qing froze: "Have you lost your mind? I've already found out—Ling Tian Zhenren has persuaded Han Xiaotian, the Supreme Elder of the Xuanwu Sect, to personally intervene, plus the Tianqing Sect's protective sect formation... even if you had three heads and six arms, you couldn't escape!" Chen Ji shook his head: "Who said I was planning to escape?" His gaze fell upon the faintly pulsing silver speck deep within his Mental Sea, as the Breaking Game Eye once again transmitted a weak fluctuation. He saw it—tonight, though extraordinarily dangerous, was also his chance to break the局面. Ling Tian Zhenren thought that setting up the Talisman of Heavenly Nets would guarantee success, yet he didn't know Chen Ji had already found another path—one no one would have imagined. "Ye Qing." he suddenly spoke, "Help me with something."

text.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji's gaze—so calm it was nearly cold—and an unusual emotion surged in her heart. She knew this man never walked the conventional path, but tonight's situation had become extremely dire—two major sects joining forces, dozens of Yuan Ying stage experts watching with predatory eyes—this was practically a death sentence. "What do you need?" she still asked. Chen Ji turned around, taking a jet-black token from his chest—the Saint Token of the Holy Sect. "Use your identity to help me activate the transport formation of the Holy Sect beneath the Tianqing Sect." Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply: "How do you know about that transport formation's existence?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "The Tianji Record told me." He paused, his gaze becoming sharp. "Moreover, I know what's at the other end of that transport formation—the outskirts of the Heavenly Dao Forbidden Grounds." Ye Qing was completely shocked. The Heavenly Dao Forbidden Grounds... even the Holy Sect didn't dare tread there lightly. Legends said terrifying existences from ancient times were sealed there—those who entered would die ten times out of ten. Chen Ji actually wanted to flee to such a place? "You've gone mad!" she exclaimed.

"Mad?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, yet unprecedented light blazed in his eyes, "Perhaps. But 'no madness, no mastery'—there has never been a safe path in this world. If you want to survive, you must walk paths others dare not take." He walked to the window, gazing at the full moon slowly rising in the sky, his voice turning low and firm: "Ling Tian Zhenren thinks his Talisman of Heavenly Nets can seal off all my escape routes, yet he forgot one thing—the holder of the Tianji Record is never trapped. Because we... can see every turning point of destiny." He turned around, his gaze fixed directly on Ye Qing: "Tonight, I will enter the Heavenly Dao Forbidden Grounds. There, I must find the second fragment of the Tianji Record." Ye Qing shuddered throughout her body: "The second fragment is in the Heavenly Dao Forbidden Grounds?" Chen Ji nodded: "The Tianji Record told me this. And..." he paused, an complex emotion flickering in his eyes, "Perhaps there, I can find clues about Chen Nian."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then made a decision that surprised Ye Qing—he decided to take the gamble. "Ye Qing, have you ever wondered..." he slowly began, his voice low, "Why must the controller of the Holy Sect cultivate you to become the Saint Maiden? Why make you cultivate that special technique? Why have you been told since childhood that you are a 'born Holy Sect physique'?" Ye Qing shuddered throughout her body, her face instantly turning deathly pale: "What... what do you mean?" Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes: "In my prophecy of the Heavenly Dao Forbidden Grounds, I saw an image—a body of an ancient Holy Sect great expert is sealed there, and that body... has a bloodline connection to you." Ye Qing felt her mind explode. Countless fragments suddenly pieced together in an instant. She had always thought she was the heaven-selected daughter chosen by the Holy Sect, yet never imagined her fate had been manipulated by others from the start. "I..." she opened her mouth, her voice hoarse, "So the Holy Sect has been using me all along?" Chen Ji nodded: "Using you might be the fact, but more importantly—do you want to know the truth? Do you want to master your own destiny?"
